quarterly_data.signal: Evaxion's Q2 2026 results release (6-K exhibit): research and development expenses were $2.3 million, aligned with Q1 2026 and slightly up from Q2 2025 as the pipeline progresses according to plan; general and administrative expenses were $1.5 million, level with Q1 2026 and down from $2.2 million in Q2 2025, mainly on lower capital market costs. The quarter's net loss compares with $3.6 million in Q1 2026 and $4.8 million in Q2 2025; cash and cash equivalents were $18.4 million at March 31, 2026; total equity was $9.5 million at June 30, 2026 versus $17.0 million at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 R&D $2.3 million; G&A $1.5 million (Q2 2025 $2.2 million); net loss Q1 2026 $3.6 million, Q2 2025 $4.8 million; cash $18.4 million at March 31, 2026; total equity $9.5 million (December 31, 2025: $17.0 million)
